verdict.rationale: Pulumi's testing guide covers in-memory unit tests that mock all external calls and integration tests that deploy ephemeral infrastructure. `pulumi preview` shows proposed changes without altering the stack, so a user or agent can validate work without touching production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of isolated sandbox/dev stacks separate from production data (stacks are only mentioned in passing), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven sandbox testing workflows.
